title: Sharp Entropy Cost of Coherent Leakage Across a Block Decomposition
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}=P\mathcal{H}\oplus Q\mathcal{H}$ and let $Πρ=PρP\oplus QρQ$ be the two-block pinching of a density matrix. Write $A=PρP$, $B=PρQ$, and $C=QρQ$. We study the block-coherence entropy $D(ρ\|Πρ)$, the relative-entropy cost of removing cross-block coherence. First, we prove a midpoint Bogoliubov--Kubo--Mori coercivity estimate, giving the operator-kernel lower bound $D(ρ\|Πρ)\ge \operatorname{Tr}[B^*Ω^{-1}_{A,C}(B)]$ for strictly positive diagonal blocks.
